$comment: A location's stored fields, by the founder's rulings of 18/11/2026 on the ID-3944 field names: the address shape (contract/collections/_address.json), shared with the company address; lat from -90 to 90 and lng from -180 to 180; a map zoom of 14 by default, whole numbers from 1 to 20; opening hours as rows of day, open, close and appointment, times stored as HH:MM. Salt for Next.js has no locations collection yet (contract/sections.json, locations), so every Salt for Next.js note here is owed with it. Locations have no page of their own.
label: Location

nextjs.owes: the collection, with this field; a target of 120 characters, shown with a count and never refused

wordpress.owes: a target of 120 characters, shown with a count and never refused

nextjs.owes: the collection, with this field (its taxonomy collection is areas)

wordpress.owes: the taxonomy box labelled Topics, with no parent control
the address shape's names: street, locality, region, postalCode, country

fields.name: lat
fields.label: Latitude
fields.description: Optional, with the longitude. Where the map's pin sits.

wordpress.formerly: geo (text, latitude and longitude separated by a comma)
wordpress.owes: two numbers, lat and lng, in place of geo

wordpress.formerly: geo (text, latitude and longitude separated by a comma)
wordpress.owes: two numbers, lat and lng, in place of geo

fields.name: zoom
fields.label: Map zoom
fields.description: How close the map starts, from 1 (the world) to 20 (a building).

wordpress.owes: the field; the map component falls back to 14 today
a text field with the email format in place of ACF's email field

fields.name: hours
fields.label: Opening hours
fields.description: Optional. Give a day two rows for a break at lunch; aim for no more than 14 rows.

wordpress.owes: the name hours, appointment in place of appointment_only, and a target of 14 rows, shown with a count and never refused

dropped.note: Unread: no view draws a location's image.

display.$comment: Derived from Salt for WordPress's inc/sections/locations.php (Salt for Next.js has no locations section yet), with the rc.7 names. markup/locations.json draws the office.

address.note: One line each, the street's two lines as two, empty parts left out.

phoneHref.note: The tel: address, only when the phone normalises to one.

hours.note: Rows in stored order; an appointment row has no open or close.

status.note: Worked out at render from hours in the site's time zone; never stored.

coordinates.note: Only when both are set; null otherwise. The map starts at zoom.

directionsHref.note: Derived from the address by each platform; never stored.
